276235646.description:
Cross
Classic Black Pen and Pencil Set - Gold-Tone Appointments
Vintage Professional Writing Instruments, Original Presentation Box
This vintage writing set from Cross features the brand's signature slim silhouette in a sophisticated matte black finish, accented by polished gold-tone hardware. As a staple of professional stationery for decades, the Cross Classic series is celebrated for its balanced weight and durable construction, representing a legacy of American craftsmanship that spans over 175 years. This particular set features a custom cross emblem on the clips, suggesting a specialized or commemorative edition.
Set includes one twist-action ballpoint pen and one twist-action mechanical pencil
Black matte finish with gold-tone clips, tips, and center rings
Custom cross emblem mounted on each clip with black and gold detailing
Original hinged presentation box with cream-colored velvet-texture interior
Condition:
Very good vintage condition overall. The matte black barrels show minimal surface wear consistent with light use. Gold-tone appointments retain a bright finish. The mechanical pencil mechanism is functional and includes an intact eraser. Ink status is not confirmed. The presentation box shows minor exterior shelf wear, but the interior remains clean and structural.

The slabs have smooth, polished faces and natural rough backs. No brand or manufacturer markings. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects.
